name: Thoma Varley
abstract_title: Identification of brain-like complex information architectures in aneural basal Xenobots.
abstract: The emergence of coordinated, higher-order patterns is a foundational feature of complex life - from the emergence of the first multicellular colonial organisms to the incredibly integrated and efficient information-processing architecture of the brain. Increasingly, scientists are using tools and ideas from complexity science and information theory to characterize the structure and function of these emergent patterns - and relate them to ideas of cognition and behavior. authors: Thoma Varley, Vaibhav Pai, Caitlin Grasso, Jeantine Lunshof, Mike Levin, Josh Bongard
